people.name: Curtis Barton
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of ALKEME INTERMEDIARY HOLDINGS, LLC)
people.bio_note: Corporate parent-level role, not a local Exeter/Scottsdale position. Curtis Barton is Co-Founder and CEO of ALKEME Insurance, the national insurance brokerage platform under which Exeter Financial's parent entity (Alkeme Intermediary Holdings LLC) sits. Over two decades of insurance industry experience, previously Founder and Chairman of Venture Pacific Insurance Services. Built ALKEME from a seven-agency collaboration in 2020 into a brokerage generating $350M+ in revenue across 35+ states via 85+ acquisitions. Holds a BA from the University of Arizona.
people.bio_source: InsurTech.ME interview (insurtech.me/insurtechtalks/2026/6/22/curtis-barton-ceo-of-alkeme) and ALKEME's own announcement (alkemeins.com/blog/alkeme-hires-industry-veteran-curtis-barton-as-chief-executive-officer); corroborated via Crunchbase profile

people.name: Anton Rosandic
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of ALKEME INTERMEDIARY HOLDINGS, LLC)
people.bio_note: Corporate parent-level role, not local to Exeter's Scottsdale office. Anton Rosandic is a Co-Founder of ALKEME Insurance and currently serves as President of ALKEME. Originally joined as COO and was promoted to the newly created President role in April 2024, overseeing corporate support functions, growth, finance, HR, business operations, and talent management across the platform, which has completed 40+ acquisitions since its 2020 founding.
people.bio_source: ALKEME press release distributed via Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com/news/alkeme-announces-promotion-anton-rosandic-131500044.html) and Newswire

people.name: Stephen Leon Harrison
people.bio_note: Managing Partner, co-founder, and Chief Compliance Officer of Exeter Financial in Scottsdale — the actual local firm leader, with the firm since 2007. Leads a team serving high-net-worth individuals, families, and related entities with integrated wealth management. Before co-founding Exeter, was Managing Director, Private Wealth Management at Friedman, Billings, Ramsey (FBR); prior to that, Senior VP at Bank of America's Private Bank and VP at Northern Trust — nearly 30 years in the industry. Holds a business degree from the University of Washington and the CIMA designation plus Series 65 and life/health insurance licenses.
people.bio_source: exeterfinancial.com/our-firm (firm's own website states his Managing Partner/CCO title and career history at Friedman Billings Ramsey, Bank of America Private Bank, and Northern Trust). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): his LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/efsteveharrison/) could not be directly re-accessed (blocked), but indirect search of the same URL's indexed content is consistent with these facts -- treating as corroborated, with the firm's own site as the primary standing source per current policy.

people.name: Boris Michael Gutin
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner, entity unmatched)
people.bio_note: Corporate parent/investor-level role, entirely unconnected to Exeter's local Scottsdale operations. Boris Michael Gutin's Exeter filing role (President of Alkeme Holdings LLC) reflects a private-equity/investor-side capacity: he is Co-Managing Partner of GCP Capital Partners, the private equity firm that has backed ALKEME's growth, including leading a 2025 continuation vehicle transaction alongside Apollo S3. Has worked with the ALKEME team for over five years.

people.name: Peter Helms
people.bio_note: Managing Partner and co-founder of Exeter Financial, part of the local Scottsdale leadership team (no CRD ownership stake on file, consistent with an operating partner rather than equity owner). Like his co-founder, came from Friedman, Billings, Ramsey (FBR) as Managing Director, Private Wealth Management; earlier was Senior VP at Bank of America's Private Bank and a Private Wealth Advisor at Merrill Lynch. Holds both a bachelor's degree and an MBA from the University of Arizona, and carries the CIMA designation plus Series 66 licensing.
people.bio_source: U.S. News & World Report financial advisor profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/peter-helms-3048228), corroborated by his LinkedIn profile

data_quality_flags: Cached ADV brochure text appears to describe a differently-named entity (Alkeme Wealth, LLC) while the firm's live website still brands as Exeter Financial — likely a parent-entity/data artifact, not a rebrand. Worth confirming before outreach.

firm_note.text: Exeter Financial, LLC operates under the corporate umbrella of Alkeme Insurance (a national insurance/wealth management aggregator platform founded 2020). Exeter is listed as a partner firm on Alkeme's own website, and its cached SEC brochure references the Alkeme entity name, while its public-facing website still brands independently as Exeter Financial. Curtis Barton, Anton Rosandic, and Boris Michael Gutin hold their ownership/officer roles at the Alkeme corporate parent level (not as local Scottsdale team members); Stephen Harrison and Peter Helms are the actual local Managing Partners/co-founders running the Scottsdale practice.
firm_note.source: alkemeins.com/partners/exeter-financial/ (Alkeme's own partner listing for Exeter Financial, corroborating the parent/platform relationship)
